targetForm: adult ornamental blue-turquoise and warm orange discus
comparisonPolicy: Google Images may locate candidates, but only the retained original pages below govern anatomy. A user-supplied aquarium photograph establishes the requested ornamental phenotype direction only. Comparisons use landmarks, qualitative proportions, and pattern boundaries without sampling, tracing, copying, redistributing, or hotlinking pixels.

targetPhenotypeScope.allowedUse: Qualitative phenotype direction only; no pixels copied, sampled, traced, embedded, redistributed, or used as a texture.
targetPhenotypeScope.description: One vivid ornamental adult with a warm orange ground, subdued dark vertical bars, dense winding blue-turquoise vermiculation, patterned warm median fins, a clearly readable seated eye, and visible small terminal lips. The target is not claimed as a named domestic strain, locality, or sex.

side.notes: Exact species photographs and the institutional description constrain the circular outline, short peduncle, seated eye, small mouth, rounded caudal, and continuous median-fin envelopes.

top.uncertainty: High. No verified true dorsal or orthographic top photograph was found; only the strong lateral-compression description and oblique views constrain width.
top.notes: The backend uses a conservative maximum width near one quarter of body depth and must not claim observed dorsal calibration.

front.uncertainty: High. No verified orthographic frontal original was found; head width and mouth projection are inferred from compression and lateral-oblique anatomy.
front.notes: Eye seating, head taper, and terminal mouth remain conservative until a calibrated frontal source is available.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: nearly circular adult lateral envelope
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Symmetric body stations and long median fins make body height approximately equal to lateral body length without producing angelfish-like points.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: short peduncle and rounded caudal
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Rapid posterior narrowing feeds a short peduncle and almost unforked rounded tail.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: small visible terminal mouth and correctly seated eye
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The eye is embedded in the head contour at a readable adult proportion, and visible small lips terminate the short snout instead of projecting as a bulbous muzzle.

proportions.name: maximum adult total length
proportions.notes: The source selects a representative 0.15 m adult at the lower end of the institutional 0.15 to 0.20 m range rather than modeling the maximum individual.

proportions.name: lateral height relative to total length
proportions.notes: UF/IFAS reports comparable 15 to 20 cm body length and height; the station and median-fin envelopes encode the near-disc ratio.

proportions.name: side-to-side width relative to vertical body depth
proportions.uncertainty: High. The ratio is a conservative procedural interpretation of very strong lateral compression, not a published Symphysodon discus morphometric.
proportions.notes: The 0.023 m maximum width over 0.098 m body depth stays near one quarter, then collapses quickly at the peduncle and snout.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: warm orange ground with subdued dark vertical bars
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Fixed-seed warm islands and softly wandering dark bars create the requested layered ornamental contrast without claiming a named strain or sampling the supplied photograph.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: dense winding blue-turquoise vermiculation and patterned warm median fins
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Intersecting warped procedural paths replace the rejected straight horizontal lines; deterministic spots and rays keep dorsal, anal, and caudal surfaces visually integrated with the body.

previousCandidate.notes: The technically valid fable-v1 candidate was visually rejected after in-tank review for its muddy ground, rigid stripes, broad thickness, and generic paired fins.

reviewedCandidate.notes: The first fable-v2 build passed source, export, runtime, determinism, and receipt gates. Visual review accepted its round silhouette but found the eye and mouth underscaled and the broad orange columns plus straight horizontal turquoise lines only loosely matched the exact user target.

repairCandidate.notes: The next fable-v2 build preserves the accepted silhouette while enlarging and seating the eye, restoring visible small lips, layering subdued dark bars over a warm ground, and replacing straight lines with denser winding turquoise paths.

mismatches.note: The passed build's seated eye reads as a small bead. The revised source increases radius without increasing protrusion.
The passed build's lips nearly disappear at side-view scale. The revised source increases lip width, radius, and short-snout offsets while keeping the mouth terminal and compact.

The passed build is dominated by broad orange columns and regular horizontal cyan lines. The revised source uses a warm ground, subdued wandering dark bars, and intersecting broken turquoise paths closer to the supplied phenotype.
Width and frontal head shape remain high-uncertainty inferences. The revised build still requires downstream visual review and explicit acceptance.

backendRepresentation.note: Each revised fable-v2 target maps to dedicated asset or backend controls. The revised source has not yet been rendered or accepted.
